items.question: Which guardian beings must be worshipped in the corners and in what concluding sequence?
premises: The ritual instruction continues with the word punaḥ.
The corners are specified as the locations for worship.
Guardian beings concluding with the eastern interval are designated as worshippable.
items.inference: Guardian beings, in a sequence ending with the eastern interval, are to be worshipped again in the corners.
uncertainties: The exact referents of rakṣaḥ in this ritual context are not specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: Again, in the corners, the guardian beings are to be worshipped in order, ending with the interval of the east.
